baseline: Fixed local 2000–2004 EVI and harmonized NDMI baselines
structural_support: Same valid reference centres at both 2000 and 2025, with complete-history companion
canopy_support: Valid 2025 centres with m>0 and observed index and baseline
recovery: Confirmed recovery stock in 2025, divided by valid 2025 centres; not a rate

units.p_m_C_r: Percent of corresponding local state fraction, centre-weighted
units.EVI_NDMI: Native index difference from local baseline

weighting: Equal-area reference centres; overlapping 500-m neighbourhoods are not added as areas
unknown: Excluded from conditional means and retained as support counts; known absence is included as zero in r/m/C but excluded from canopy means
